verdict.rationale: The public docs say each hosted model is listed with its context, regions and price for each service tier, so founders can see per-model pricing in self-serve documentation without contacting sales. The model-picker claim is the only pricing evidence, and no actual price figures or units appear in the pack. The 'higher limits on demand' note covers rate limits, not price disclosure. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that prices are quoted per token, actual price figures or a pricing page captured by probe, and independent corroboration that every model is priced publicly.
